claims.claim: A layer is one versioned unit: layer.json plus replace and merge mode trees and an optional files overlay
Layer kinds base, feature, surface, sample-data, theme with the kind as directory prefix
Base is framework-only: framework SQL and base.contract.json, zero catalogue, zero content
Additions bind only to the base contract, never to each other
Editions compose from, add, surfaces, sampleData, themes
Five editions: base-only, base-swift, swift-demo, headless-demo, dap-portal
expectedCounts and criticalPaths per edition
Feature layers (reordering, pricing, subscription orders, BOM configurator, B2B comms, gallery zoom) with fixture probes

excluded.reason: Each feature layer's outcome (quick order, contract pricing, subscriptions, kits, dealer mails, gallery zoom) belongs to the commerce and content area authors; the layer carriage itself is edition-composition.

claims.claim: Surface layers swift, headless, dap-portal
One sample-data layer on the sampleData toggle with personas and catalogue
theme-default with the brand slot
gateProven in layers/INDEX.json is the only record of which editions are proven
Pin origin/main; main is the version; tags are provenance only
Retired layer names resolve to their successor, never silence
Version floors rise only when a consumer depends on the fix
base.contract.json compat: DW ring and min, Swift tag, required Serializer and optional MCP floors
Proof key provenTree: per-layer tree hash checked by CI
Bacpac release assets registered with sha256, gated after restore, scrub-checked
Restoring a bacpac: verify sha256, import onto a new database, set the administrator password
Every edition delivers onto a blank DW10 database from the stock setup wizard
Collision checks between layers at activation

excluded.reason: Layer-authoring gate run before merge, not a property of a delivered host.

claims.claim: Rolling latest-only Swift support

gaps: edition-composition, release-compatibility and artifact-verification need runtime inputs read from the locked Distribution commit (edition tables, floors, hashes); contract.md defines no tokens for them, so every binding is planned.
The gateProven record names DW 10.29.8 while versions/spine.json current still reads 10.29.7 at the commit read; the ledger cites gateProven as the authority, as the README says.
Feature-layer fixture probes (cart-price, sku-validation, checkout-recurring, bom-cart-lines) are not migrated into this ledger.
This is an earlier-release candidate test inventory. Current documentation navigation is not evidence of availability on this baseline; see evidence/admission.json and the exact-baseline report.
